agile_croucher.description: Your movement speed while crouching is increased.
agile_croucher.name: Agile Croucher

back_on_your_feet.description: When you're critically hurt, your health regenerates until a certain limit.
back_on_your_feet.name: Back On Your Feet

broad_shoulders.description: Increases the maximum weight you can carry.
broad_shoulders.name: Broad Shoulders

bull_rush.description: When your weapon is stowed, allows you to knock back players and ARC while sprinting.
bull_rush.name: Bull Rush

crawl_before_you_walk.description: When you're downed, you crawl faster.
crawl_before_you_walk.name: Crawl Before You Walk

downed_but_determined.description: When you're downed, it takes longer before you collapse.
downed_but_determined.name: Downed But Determined

field_repair.description: Allows you to repair weapons, shields and gadgets up to 30% durability while in a round.
field_repair.name: Field Repair

fight_or_flight.description: When you're hurt in combat, regain a fixed amount of stamina.  Has a cooldown between uses.
fight_or_flight.name: Fight Or Flight

gentle_pressure.description: You make less noise when breaching.
gentle_pressure.name: Gentle Pressure

in_round_crafting.description: Unlocks the ability to field-craft items while topside.
in_round_crafting.name: In-Round Crafting

in_the_flow.description: Chaining together mobility moves while sprinting increases the speed, and reduces the stamina cost.
in_the_flow.name: In The Flow

loaded_arms.description: Your equipped weapon has less impact on your encumbrance.
loaded_arms.name: Loaded Arms

looters_instincts.description: When searching a container, loot is revealed faster.
looters_instincts.name: Looter's Instincts

looters_luck.description: While looting, there's a chance to reveal twice as many items at once.
looters_luck.name: Looter's Luck

minesweeper.description: Mines and explosive deployables can be defused when in close proximity
minesweeper.name: Minesweeper

nimble_climber.description: You can climb and vault more quickly.
nimble_climber.name: Nimble Climber

nomadic_crafting.description: Allows you to field craft a much wider range of items.
nomadic_crafting.name: Nomadic Crafting

proficient_pryer.description: Breaching doors and containers takes less time.
proficient_pryer.name: Proficient Pryer

quick_roll.description: A faster version of the Dodge Roll, at reduced stamina cost. Covers a shorter distance.
quick_roll.name: Quick Roll

ready_to_roll.description: When falling, your timing window to perform a Recovery Roll is increased.
ready_to_roll.name: Ready To Roll

right_back_at_it.description: Reduces the time to get back up after a heavy landing.
right_back_at_it.name: Right Back At It

road_warrior.description: Increases the amount of ammo and ARC Powercells looted from ARC, and allows you to recycle at full efficiency while in a round.
road_warrior.name: Road Warrior

silent_scavenger.description: You make less noise when looting.
silent_scavenger.name: Silent Scavenger

slip_and_slide.description: You can slide further and faster.
slip_and_slide.name: Slip and Slide

speedy_mule.description: Reduces the speed penalty when severely over-encumbered.
speedy_mule.name: Speedy Mule

sprinting_on_fumes.description: Stamina never fully drains while sprinting. Any action or damage cancels the skill.  Recovery time scales with duration.
sprinting_on_fumes.name: Sprinting On Fumes

stubborn_mule.description: Your stamina regeneration is less affected by being over-encumbered.
stubborn_mule.name: Stubborn Mule

sturdy_ankles.description: You take less fall damage when falling from a non-lethal height.
sturdy_ankles.name: Sturdy Ankles

stylish_landing.description: You can use the Recovery Roll from higher up.
stylish_landing.name: Stylish Landing

sure_footed_scrambler.description: While sprinting, increases the time you can scramble up steep slopes.
sure_footed_scrambler.name: Sure-Footed Scrambler

swift_start.description: Increases the duration of the high speed at the start of a sprint.
swift_start.name: Swift Start

three_deep_breaths.description: After an ability drains your stamina, you recover more quickly.
three_deep_breaths.name: Three Deep Breaths

traveling_tinkerer.description: Unlocks additional items to field craft.
traveling_tinkerer.name: Traveling Tinkerer

turtle_crawl.description: While downed, you take less damage.
turtle_crawl.name: Turtle Crawl

used_to_the_weight.description: Wearing a shield doesn't slow you down as much.
used_to_the_weight.name: Used To The Weight

vault_n_carry.description: Lets you vault while holding a carryable.
vault_n_carry.name: Vault 'n' Carry

vault_spring.description: Lets you jump at the end of a vault.
vault_spring.name: Vault Spring

vigorous_vaulter.description: Vaulting is no longer slowed down while exhausted.
vigorous_vaulter.name: Vigorous Vaulter

wall_run.description: Sprinting at a wall allows you to run up it for a few steps.
wall_run.name: Wall Run

weapon_bash.description: Lets you perform a melee attack using your equipped weapon.
weapon_bash.name: Weapon Bash
